remarks: Welcome to this exceptional Laguna Niguel residence, where breathtaking panoramic views and expansive outdoor living come together in a truly remarkable setting. Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, the home captures approximately 270 degrees of sweeping city lights, rolling hills and mountain views, with an extraordinary 190 feet of view frontage creating a sense of openness and privacy rarely found in Orange County. Situated on an expansive lot of over 11,000 square feet, the property offers an outdoor retreat designed for entertaining and enjoying Southern California living.
